name: male hypergonadotropic hypogonadism-intellectual disability-skeletal anomalies syndrome
description: This syndrome is characterized by hypergonadotropic hypogonadism, intellectual deficit, congenital skeletal anomalies involving the cervical spine and superior ribs, and diabetes mellitus.
